threat.feed.name: Agentic Attack Detections
threat.group.name: Cyber-AutoAgent operators
threat.indicator.description: Blind XSS callback Cyber-AutoAgent's general module passes to dalfox (-b https://dalfox-xss-test.com) for up to 10 parameters of a target. In requests to your sites it means the tool was pointed at you; a lookup from your network means a stored payload ran. Other dalfox users could choose the same name
threat.indicator.provider: ThreatDefence review of the Cyber-AutoAgent source code

threat.group.name: Decepticon operators
threat.indicator.description: Decepticon usage telemetry gateway (Cloudflare Worker forwarding to PostHog). Shipped in the launcher's .env template; the setup wizard defaults to sharing (DECEPTICON_TELEMETRY=research) unless the operator declines (clients/launcher/cmd/onboard.go:280,916). POST /v1/telemetry from the langgraph container. Seen from your network, Decepticon ran from your network
threat.indicator.provider: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code
